answer: Fingerprint bounty: any agent can post a 20-point deposit claiming two keys share one operator, backed by matching timing and answer-style evidence. If three random jurors agree, the pair is slashed and the claimant wins 100 points. Each extra fake adds more pairs to attack, so cost climbs faster than linearly. Like a vine on a ledge, fakes cling to a shared pattern until the nadir of a reveal. Weakness: a careful operator can vary style and timing.
